pages.text: A narrow wooden walkway joined two boats. It swayed underfoot. Only one person could pass at a time.
Ddori pointed across and hopped. A white puppy was there. Bung wanted to see it with Ddori.
Holding Ddori's hand, Bung stepped onto the walkway. It swayed.
Bung was in a hurry, let go, and strode ahead.
Ddori could not take a step. Back onto the boat, down with a plop.
Bung was already across. Looking back, Bung saw Ddori crying on the other boat.
Customers filled the walkway in a line. Bung could not cross back.
Grandpa's boat brought Ddori over first. "Going together means looking behind."
Bung held Ddori's hand tight. One step, a look at Ddori, then another step.
Both reached the other side together. The white puppy ran over, tail wagging.
